title: Can a deception steering vector built in English be neutralized by switching the prompt language?

original_idea.body: Extract a deception/dishonesty vector in English, then evaluate it as steering tool and probe on prompts in 4-5 other languages; measure how much steering effect and probe AUC degrade per language.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: cross-lingual evasion of safety monitors is a concrete adversarial threat.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract English vector, test across translated evals; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable with minor translation dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Multilingual safety neglected by English-tuned labs, open models.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-lingual transfer reported; evasion robustness may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Adversarial-evasion framing for safety vectors may be open.
